name: ralhf
description: RaLHF — turns Claude into your personal context engineer. Before any task, RaLHF collaborates with you to assemble a context package from your RaLHF wiki, Claude's memory, local files, and connected apps. Five-phase flow (Load → Discover → Propose → Confirm → Execute → Remember) with staged check-ins, verified-present connector inventory, and structured feedback capture. Points at backend.ralhf.ai.
